title: The bishop(?) of Fermo to Sforza Attendolo, Naples, 10 March 1413: a royal marriage offer, wholly in cipher (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 12, DECODE R4790)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308, fasc. 2 "Lettere in cifra", no. 12; DECODE R4790 (Concistoro_2308_44), images P1 (verso, address) and P2 (letter); second photograph R1858 p. 7
documents.route: Naples -> Sforza Attendolo (at Perugia, per the report's sources)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the record or in print; R1858 (marked Decrypted) has no document attached and its photograph of no. 12 carries no gloss (checked 18 Oct 2026).

transcription.source: George Lasry with CTTS: transcription by Claude, refined by George Lasry in CTTS (report, 17 Oct 2026)
transcription.notes: Counts from the report: 865 cipher symbols (822 in the 16-line letter on P2, 43 in the 3-line address on the verso) and 95 word dividers; the key figure's occurrence counts add up to 865 (850 letter signs, 9 nomenclature, 6 unknown). The CTTS transcription itself is not in the repository, so nothing is re-measured. The report says accurate transcription was the main obstacle across the fascicle.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution on graphic signs with word dividers: two to three signs for each vowel and several consonants, a crown sign for 'Re' and a few name signs (report: 46 distinct signs).
system.sibling_key: none known; not the key of nos. 20/23 (R4808, R4811, same spring, siena2023) and not one of the 43 filed keys of fasc. 1
system.notes: Per letter counted on the report's key figure (key_lasry.jpg). Nulls and separators: two signs (53 and 42 occurrences = the report's 95 word dividers). Nomenclature: crown = RE (4), 'Signoria Vostra?' (2), two 'name?' signs (2, 1). Six signs of one occurrence each are 'unknown'. Split from siena1421 on 18 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (report heading B, one piece).

prior_solution.where: None known. The project's siena1421 notes (24 Sept 2026) had 'taken no. 12 as read' from R1858's status, without a reading. Cryptoole XX15XX-97 'solved/plaintext_attached' is a group status over the Concistoro records. Meister 1902 and the 1952 inventory print no reading.

texts.label: No. 12 (R4790), [the bishop of Fermo?] to Sforza Attendolo, Naples, 10 March 1413 (George Lasry)
texts.summary: Signed 'Vescovi(?) de Fermo', to Sforza Attendolo, 'magnifico capitanio', Naples, 10 March 1413: Carlo di Ludovico da Cesena reports that King Ladislaus is willing to make a marriage alliance with Sforza and offers two girls of his house, the daughter of Ludovico di messer Gianni de' Malatesti or the daughter of Niccolò Filippo Brancaleoni of Castel Durante. Sforza married Caterina Alopo in 1415, so the offer came to nothing. Decryption and translation are George Lasry's, verbatim from his report; his CTTS transcription is not in the repository.

reading_review.note: v5 check 23 Oct 2026 (plain bar, VERIFY5_BRIEF): the letter is Italian (Neapolitan, 1413), not French: older spelling, explicit-hole bar. reading_no12.txt (Lasry's decipherment verbatim): explicit holes 0.708 (17/24), plain 0.25 (dialect forms: vuie, doe, pigliole, mamole, legiptima); the holes are his [?] signs and the name signs. Sentences hold. Keeps read.
